# cairo-nft-combo

This repository contains a Cairo component for building NFT contracts on Starknet.
It extends OpenZeppelin's ERC-721 implementation with additional features like:
- Sequential minting
- Max supply and reserved supply management
- Pausable minting
- Contract-level metadata (ERC-7572)
- Metadata updates (ERC-4906)
- Royalties (ERC-2981)

## Documentation for Agents

If you are an AI agent looking to integrate this package, please read:
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Detailed integration guide and examples.

## Key Source Files

- [erc721_combo.cairo](packages/nft_combo/src/erc721/erc721_combo.cairo): Main component implementation.
- [interface.cairo](packages/nft_combo/src/common/interface.cairo): Interface definitions.
